messages:
jamie: prepping midnight change window 2026-03-24 00:30 UTC. Plan: pin runtime v2.4.1, deploy api v3.0.0-beta (canary), console schema bump (v1.8.2). Router header-swap to route by X-Runtime-Version. Who's ok for a 5% canary then ramp?

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment window 2026-03-24 00:30 UTC for services: runtime, api, console, router. Runbook: https://go/runbook/123. Checklist: tests green, canary=5%, rollback=auto-fallback allowed.

kai: runtime note: kernel change in 2.4.1 affects mem allocator; warmup recommended (2min). If mem delta >+30% or OOMs, fallback to v2.3.9. Also KV eviction policy tweak in this rollout — watch kv_miss rate.

maria: api heads-up: header contract changes for auth header normalization. will gate under feature flag ff/api-header-normalize. Canary 5% for 15m then 25%. Fallback route available -> header X-Use-Old set.

sam: console: schema bump compatible but client lib needs minor change; migration flag ready. Need console -> api compatibility test pass before ramping past 25%. pin script: `./pin_version.sh console v1.8.2`

jamie: proposed rollback criteria: error rate spike >3% sustained over 10m OR p95 >800ms for 5m OR OOM/segfaults on runtime. Confirm owners and signal channel (we'll use #eng-oncall + @maria + @kai).

kai: ack. I'll watch mem and kv metrics. Fallback plan: pin routing to runtime v2.3.9 and pause router header-swap. I can run rollback with `tools/rollback/runtime --to v2.3.9`

sam: release notes updated: https://go/release-notes/console-1.8.2. Also rotating ephemeral tokens during cutover (expect ~30s auth blips). Flagging for canary.

maria: router: will add header check for X-Runtime-Version. For canary we'll send header to 5% of traffic. Adding guard: if header absent, route to old runtime.

deploy-bot: canary started for api v3.0.0-beta at 2026-03-24 00:31 UTC -> 5% traffic. Monitoring hooks: https://go/telemetry/abc.

jamie: seeing a small 502 blip on canary (5 nodes) — @kai can you check kv eviction logs?

kai: looking. quick grep from canary hosts: `grep -i 'evict' /var/log/runtime.log | tail -n 50` shows small burst around 00:34 -> increase in evicted keys by ~12%. Investigating.

maria: API errors correlate: 502s -> spike in downstream timeouts to runtime. Rolling hold. Pausing ramp.

sam: holding console rollout. not proceeding to 25%.

deploy-bot: canary paused by jamie at 2026-03-24 00:36 UTC.

jamie: decision: pause and rollback runtime to v2.3.9 for safety. Kai please execute rollback, update when done. We'll re-run tests and re-open window later.

kai: rollback to v2.3.9 started. Command: `tools/rollback/runtime --to v2.3.9 --reason 'canary 502s/kv-evict'`. ETA 3m.

deploy-bot: runtime rollback completed at 2026-03-24 00:40 UTC. Canary aborted.

jamie: thanks all. Opening a short postmortem thread. We'll keep the api and console pinned for now. Next steps: run memprof and KV tuning, re-run a dry canary on staging then a new midnight window. :thumbsup:
